messages:
Maria Gonzales: Quick sync — we're planning a focused 'Dev Journey' week around the RefApp reference app. Goal: short tutorial series + 30-min webinar + a benchmark narrative post. Need clear owners for copy, benchmarks, webinar ops, short demo video, and inbound routing for leads.
Samir Patel: I can own benchmarks. What sample corpora and target metrics do we want? reuse the small-convo set?
Jin Park: I'll own the tutorial steps and repo cleanup. ETA Tue EOD for initial PR.
Elaine Wong: I'll run webinar ops (slides, demo script, RT). Need a reliable small-model for the live demo (no giant weights).
marketing-bot: New campaign scaffold created: https://docs.redwood.com/campaigns/devjourney-refapp — add assets there. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzales: Great. Samir — can you surface one clear benchmark chart (latency vs cost vs quality) we can use in the announcement? Prefer 2 lines: hosted API vs dedicated pool.
Samir Patel: Yep. I'll produce a chart showing median latency and $/1k tokens. Quick Q: include quantized variants or keep it simple?
Jin Park: For the tutorial, include a short how-to for local dev with a one-liner. Example:
```
docker run -p 8080:8080 redwood/refapp:local
```
Also add a 'known issues' mini-section.
Elaine Wong: Proposed webinar slot: Wed 11am PT. @ops-jen can you reserve streaming link + ensure recording + fallback RT?
ops-jen: Reserved Wed 11am PT, streaming link created: https://meet.redwood.com/streams/rdw123 — recording + backup stream configured.
Maria Gonzales: Messaging guardrails: keep announcement developer-focused — 'playbooks for shipping inference' and 'benchmarks devs can act on'. Avoid heavy enterprise jargon in the first post.
Samir Patel: Draft benchmark narrative uploaded: https://docs.redwood.com/benchmarks/devjourney-bench-draft — I'm planning: dataset, config, costs, summary takeaway.
Jin Park: Pushed tutorial PR: https://github.com/redwood/refapp/pull/123 — includes step-by-step and sample prompts.
Elaine Wong: Slide plan: 7-min demo, 10-min Q&A, 5-min how-to + CTA to try hosted API and self-host guide. Need final slides Thu morning.
Maria Gonzales: Timeline summary: draft copy by Mon EOD, tutorial PR by Tue, benchmark chart Wed AM, webinar Wed 11am PT, announcement Thu 9am PT. Social seeds Thu 9am.
Samir Patel: Noted. @marketing-bot please schedule social posts (Twitter, LinkedIn, dev.to) to align with Thu 9am announcement.
marketing-bot: Social seeds scheduled for Thu 09:00 PT; follow-ups set for Fri 12:00 PT and next Wed 09:00 PT.
Elaine Wong: Suggest adding a 60–90s 'how-to' screen capture for the community (demo + one-liner). Who can record?
Jin Park: I can record a quick walkthrough Thu morning.
Maria Gonzales: Quick checklist to keep in the campaign doc:
```
- copy draft (Maria)
- tutorial PR (Jin)
- benchmark chart (Samir)
- webinar ops + slides (Elaine)
- social schedule (marketing-bot)
- demo vid (Jin)
- streaming link + recording (ops-jen)
```
Ping me if anything slips.
Samir Patel: One last ask for the benchmark narrative — include simple USD cost numbers per 1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated with quantized baseline as an appendix.
Maria Gonzales: Agreed. Keep the headline numbers simple and transparent. Appendix can list variants.
Elaine Wong: All set on webinar ops; I'll prepare a pre-recorded backup demo and live fallback notes.
Maria Gonzales: Thanks everyone — let's sync if blockers pop up.
